en.title: Style documents with themes
en.description: Choose a coordinated color and typography theme for an existing artifact.
tasks: Choose a coordinated color and typography theme for an existing artifact.
prerequisites: An existing document or page and a tool able to edit its format and view PDFs.
en.example: Use theme-factory. Show the theme options, then apply my selected theme to this report without changing the content.
en.expectedResult: A consistently styled artifact with a documented palette and font pairing.
limitations: This package supplies themes; it does not include a slide or document editing application.

zh.title: 文档主题配色
zh.description: 为已有文档或页面选择协调的颜色与字体主题。
tasks: 为已有文档或页面选择协调的颜色与字体主题。
prerequisites: 已有文档或页面，以及可编辑该格式、查看 PDF 的工具。
zh.example: 请使用 theme-factory：展示主题选项，再把我选中的主题应用到报告，保持正文内容不变。
zh.expectedResult: 风格一致的成品及配色、字体搭配说明。
limitations: 此包提供主题，不包含幻灯片或文档编辑应用。
